title: Boots Black Friday 2026: dates, best deals and Star Gifts
description: Boots Black Friday 2026 is live: when it started, how Star Gifts and current codes work, and last year's prices on Oral-B, ghd, Dyson and perfume.
intro:
**Boots's Black Friday 2026 sale is already live. It started on Wednesday 28 October with more than 3,000 products reduced.** Boots hasn't given an end date. Last year it ran until Cyber Monday, which falls on 30 November this year.

Alongside it, Boots is running weekly half-price Star Gifts and, as of 2 November, codes for 15% off when you spend £60 (SAVE15) or 10% off a £40 spend (SAVE10) on almost everything. This page covers how to use them, and the Black Friday prices worth waiting for on Oral-B, ghd, Dyson and fragrance. Last checked: 2 November 2026.

body:
## When does Boots Black Friday 2026 start?

It already has. Boots's 2026 Black Friday sale went live on **Wednesday 28 October**, with more than 3,000 products reduced, a month before Black Friday itself. No end date has been announced. Here's what it did before:

- **2025:** early Black Friday deals started at the end of October, and the sale ended on Cyber Monday, 1 December.
- **2024:** Boots ran offers through November, with its biggest weekend from 29 November to 2 December.
- **2021 and 2022:** Black Friday ran for the whole of November.

So expect more offers to be added through November, with the deepest cuts over Black Friday weekend. See our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) for other retailers.

## Boots Star Gifts 2026: how they work

Star Gifts are Boots's weekly Christmas gift offers, and they're often better than its Black Friday deals.

- They started on 12 August 2026, and new ones are added every week until Christmas.
- Each one is **half price or better**, and usually runs from Friday to the following Thursday.
- They're sold while stocks last, and the most popular ones sell out fast.
- Star Gifts are generally **not** included in 3 for 2.
- Online and in-store stock can differ, so check both.

Recent Star Gifts have included Oral-B iO electric toothbrushes, a Philips Sonicare, No7 skincare sets and designer perfume such as YSL Black Opium. They really do end: the YSL Black Opium Over Red 50ml was half price as a late-October Star Gift and is back to £80 (was £100) as of 2 November. If you see one you want, buy it that week. It's unlikely to come back cheaper.

## 3 for 2 and this week's codes

Boots's Christmas 3 for 2 makes the cheapest item free. On 2 November we couldn't see a site-wide gift 3 for 2 running (only 3 for 2 on No7 Future Renew), so check the product page before relying on it. What is running is **SAVE15** (15% off a £60 spend) and **SAVE10** (10% off a £40 spend) across almost everything, with no end date shown. In past years the 3 for 2 has covered gift sets from brands like Soap & Glory, No7, Yankee Candle, Baylis & Harding and Sanctuary. In 2024, Boots switched to 4 for 2 later in the season, so if you're buying lots of small gifts, it can pay to wait for that.

## Advantage Card prices and points

You earn 3 points per £1 at Boots, and each point is worth 1p. On top of that, Price Advantage gives cardholders member-only prices on thousands of products. Some of Boots's best Black Friday prices are Advantage Card only, so sign up before the sale if you haven't already. It's free.

## Boots beauty advent calendars 2026

Boots's 2026 calendars went on sale on 2 September. They launched at £65 for the No7 25 Days of Beauty, £70 for Boots 24 Days of Skin, £90 for the new Boots 12 Days of Scent, £150 for 24 Days of Luxe Beauty and £180 for the No7 Ultimate Beauty calendar. Popular calendars often sell out before Black Friday. Our [beauty advent calendars guide](/guides/beauty-advent-calendars-2026/) compares them with rivals.

## What was cheap at Boots last Black Friday

These 2025 Black Friday prices are the ones to aim for:

- Oral-B iO2 electric toothbrush: £35 (was £100)
- Philips Sonicare 3100: £34.99 (was £89.99)
- ghd Helios hair dryer: £139 (was £179)
- Dyson Airwrap Origin: £299.99 (was £399.99)
- Dyson Supersonic Origin: £189.99 (was £279.99)

For brand-by-brand advice, see our guides to [Oral-B](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/), [ghd](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [perfume gift sets](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/).

## Buy now or wait?

**Buy now:** a Star Gift you want, and any advent calendar, because both sell out. **Wait:** electric toothbrushes, hair tools and Dyson, which were cheapest over Black Friday weekend last year. Prices on these brands vary between shops, so compare Boots with Amazon before you buy.

### When is Boots Black Friday 2026?

It started on Wednesday 28 October 2026 and is running now. Boots hasn't given an end date; last year the sale finished on Cyber Monday, and this year Cyber Monday is 30 November.

### What are Boots Star Gifts?

Weekly Christmas gift offers at half price or better. New ones arrive every week until Christmas, usually running Friday to Thursday, while stocks last.

### Can you use 3 for 2 on Star Gifts?

Usually not. Star Gifts are generally excluded from the 3 for 2 offer.

### Are Boots Black Friday deals better with an Advantage Card?

Often, yes. Some deals are only for cardholders, and you also earn points worth 1p each. The card is free.

Find more on our [Black Friday hub](/black-friday/) and our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).
